email.subject: Certificate of Participation - ML Accelerator: TechSprint Hackathon Prep Workshop
email.body_text:
Dear {name} 🎉,

Congratulations on successfully participating in the ML Accelerator: TechSprint Hackathon Prep workshop, organized by GDG On Campus, PRMIT&R.

This workshop focused on strengthening your Machine Learning fundamentals and preparing you for hackathons like TechSprint. We truly appreciate the effort, curiosity, and active participation you showed throughout the workshop.

Please find your Certificate of Participation attached with this email.

Certificate ID: {certificate_id}

Your certificate will be verifiable through the official verification portal from late January 2026. Until then, you may share it on professional or social platforms.

Regards,
Vedant Mali
Organizer
GDG On Campus, PRMIT&R
